description: pith: keeps the first user from reading git history or Claude Code conversation records, and checks every result file written against its form

hooks.command: if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pretooluse.py"; else case "$(cat)" in *'"agent_type":"pith:first-user"'*|*'"agent_type": "pith:first-user"'*) echo 'pith: stopped because its checks need Python 3.9 or later; install Python 3.9 or later and run again.' >&2; exit 2;; esac; exit 0; fi

if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/posttooluse.py"; else case "$(cat)" in *'/open/'*'-report-'*) echo 'pith: a result file cannot be checked without Python 3.9 or later; install Python 3.9 or later and run again.' >&2; exit 2;; esac; exit 0; fi
